headword: {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}
gloss: fully prepared; all set; everything in readiness

definitions.gloss: fully prepared; all set; everything in readiness
definitions.explanation: A state where all preparations are complete and nothing is left to do. Expresses thorough readiness.

examples.japanese: {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}だ。
{旅行|りょこう}の{準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}が{整|ととの}った。
examples.english: All the travel preparations are in order.

examples.japanese: {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}で{試合|しあい}に{臨|のぞ}んだのに、{結果|けっか}は{散々|さんざん}だった。
examples.english: Despite being fully prepared for the match, the result was terrible.

notes:
Composed of {準備|じゅんび} (preparation) + {万端|ばんたん} (everything, all matters). {万端|ばんたん} literally means 'ten thousand ends' — every loose end is tied up. Often used as a predicate with だ or as an adverbial modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}だ: to be all set
- {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}が{整|ととの}う: all preparations come together
- {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}で{臨|のぞ}む: to face something fully prepared

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {万全|ばんぜん}: perfect, flawless (describes the state of readiness itself, not specifically preparations)
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}: thoroughly prepared (emphasizes careful planning rather than completion of tasks)

USAGE:
Can function as a noun ({準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}が{整|ととの}った) or as a な-adjective-like predicate ({準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}だ). Often used with an optimistic or confident tone.
